# Semlink 2.4.1

A compliance patch with no behavior changes: cleans up the CSS lint findings from the community plugin review.

## 🧹 Styles cleanup

- Removed all `:has()` selectors (11 sites, a broad-invalidation performance risk):
  - The home-screen grid gate now relies on its JS-toggled state class alone, which already tracks the exact same condition
  - Drawer rows with an unread dot carry an explicit `is-unread` class set at render time (pin hiding and left padding unchanged)
  - The project drill-down rows suppress the chip highlight while the "drill down" entry is hovered via a pointer-tracked class instead of `:has()`
- Removed a duplicate `padding` declaration in the thinking-panel block styles

**Download**: main.js, manifest.json and styles.css are attached to this release. Updating from inside Obsidian picks up all three automatically.
